description: This file implements the FinishSetupSource class, which is responsible for finalizing the setup of media sources in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes callback functions for GStreamer appsrc events, manages attaching media streams (audio and video), and notifies the client of the playback state.

classes.name: FinishSetupSource
classes.description: A class that finalizes the setup of media sources in a GStreamer pipeline, attaching audio and video streams and notifying the client of the playback state.

methods.name: FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FinishSetupSource with the media context, player, and client.

methods.name: ~FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Destructor for FinishSetupSource, logs the destruction.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the final setup steps: attaching media streams, setting up app sources, and notifying the client of the idle state.
